description: US macro figures for agents reading Robinhood Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain, from public primary sources, each with its date: the Treasury daily par yield curve (1 month to 30 years), the New York Fed's effective federal funds rate with its target range, and from BLS the CPI-U change year on year, the unemployment rate and the monthly change in nonfarm payrolls (P = preliminary). No input. The EFFR is subject to the Terms of Use posted at newyorkfed.org; Toll is not affiliated with the New York Fed.
name: macro
title: US macro figures
